title: Choose a result
summary: Scala: Choose a result. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: An if expression can return one of two values. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.

blocks.title: Choose a result
blocks.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  val score = 8
  val message = if score >= 5 then "Pass" else "Try again"
  println(message)

blocks.text: The condition is true, so message receives the then value Pass.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An expression that must return a value needs both branches.
